I made another structural pass focused on raising the abstraction level instead of just moving code around.

[PairMatch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/002_two_pointers_technique/PairMatch.java:1) is now a top-level result type instead of a nested detail inside `TwoPointers`, which makes the API cleaner and the result reusable. The search loop is simpler and the index/value mapping logic is centralized in one place.
